mod.overview: Tribal Combat is a tactical total-conversion mod for Starsiege Tribes by Despised (February 2000) that slows down reckless solo play in favor of specialized roles, dual-mode weapons, base-fortification engineering, and strict team discipline. Players spawn in Combat Armor by default (with selectable Attack, Defense, Repair, or Sniper respawn roles) and adapt at inventory stations across five distinct armor classes, each carrying its own grenade type and an active Special ability such as a Jump Thruster, Emergency Medkit, Energy Reserve, Assault Shield, or Broadcast Power. Firefights emphasize weapon-and-pack synergies, headshots, toggleable fire modes, remote-piloted drones, and deployable Force Screens, teleporters, mines, and vehicle pads, while anti-griefing rules enforce full team damage, an initial CTF flag truce, and exile to a third TRAITOR team for repeated team-killers. Combat-ready maps include seven dedicated Tribal Combat missions with the TRAITOR team enabled, and servers can also vote to disable specific item categories or switch to a stripped-down Simulated Base mode.
notes: Five armor classes (with female variants for Light, Combat, and Medium) each have a unique Special ability triggered via the Beacon/Special slot and different grenade types: Light (larmor/lfemale, speed 16, 3 weapons, Hand Grenades) fires a Jump Thruster forward and up with a 20s recharge; Combat (carmor/fcarmor, speed 12, 4 weapons, Hand Grenades) triggers Emergency Medical Kits to heal 0.35 damage; Medium (marmor/mfemale, speed 9, 4 weapons, Demo Grenades) restores full energy when below 40% and carries nearly all deployables, turrets, and structures; Assault (harmor, speed 6.5, 5 weapons, Blast Grenades) auto-equips an integral 25mm AutoCannon and toggles an Assault Shield that stops energy recharge while active; Defender (darmor, speed 3, 5 weapons, Blast Grenades) auto-equips an integral Field Repair Unit and projects Broadcast Power to run an unpowered Inventory or Ammo station within 5m.

Controls and menus: Run exec("combatConfig.cs"); in the console once to bind 0 to UseSpecial, F11/F12 to WeaponModeNext/WeaponModePrev, and holding/releasing C to PlayerKneel/PlayerStand. Through the Tab Options menu, players can choose their Respawn Role (Attack, Defense, Repair, or Sniper with a 12.5mm SniperRifle), toggle custom skins (enemy team skins are blocked), or start votes for Mission, Initial Truce length, Damage Mode (low, normal, high, custom if enabled), and Item Mode (Combat vs Simulated Base or toggling Vehicles, Turrets, Emplacements, Structures, Teleports, Traps, and Drones).

Eight weapons feature dual fire modes toggled with F11/F12: 7mm Chaingun (Regulated vs Very Rapid Fire 3-round burst), 14.5mm Heavy Chaingun (Accurate vs 2-round Spread), 12mm Machine Pistol (3-round Burst vs Silent single shot), 25mm AutoCannon (HEAP explosive vs HVAP armor-piercing), Grenade Launcher (Regular vs 2-round impact AGL burst), Assault Mortar (Normal vs Close Quarters), Rocket Launcher (Single vs 4-rocket Salvo), and Missile Launcher (AutoTarget homing vs player-guided GuidedMissile). Several weapons are paired to specific packs (EDGun with ShieldPack, TransferGun with RepairPack, PlasmaRepeater with CoolantPack, LaserRifle/Pulse Laser/Energy Cannon with EnergyPack) and auto-buy or auto-sell together.

Base engineering, traps, and remote assets expand team tactics: Medium and Defender armors can deploy Force Screens (friendly-passable barriers weak to EDGun drain), Barricades (explode on nearby turrets/sensors when destroyed), Remote Snipers, MRLs, AutoCannons, Anti-Aircraft Cannons, ELF/Plasma/Missile turrets, Defense Grid Nodes (350m sensors), Stealth Mines (fade invisible after 8s), Anti-Armor Mines, Teleport Pads/Fields, Floating Pads (mid-air platforms under 300m that detonate on destruction), and field Vehicle Base Pads/Controls. Players can also fly four remote drones (Camera Drone, Beacon Survey Drone, Attack Drone, and Guided Bomb; press jump to self-destruct and dismount).

Vehicles and armor restrictions: Alongside the Scout (mini fusion guns), LAPC (2 passengers), and HAPC (4 passengers), Combat adds the agile Fighter (SpeederVehicle with twin heavy chainguns), slow armored Assault Craft (HTVehicle hovertank firing HEAP shells, 4.0 maxDamage), and Bomber (drops high-radius Bombs). Only Light and Combat armors can pilot vehicles, Medium and Assault can only ride as passengers in transports, and Defender armor is completely barred from entering any vehicle.

Rules and anti-griefing: Team damage is forced on ($Server::TeamDamageScale = 1), and Inventory Stations auto-eject players after 20 seconds by default ($Combat::INVBootTime). On CTF maps, an initial truce (default 2 minutes) kills anyone touching the enemy flag early. Committing 5 team kills ($Server::MaxTeamKills) exiles the player to team 2 (TRAITOR) on Combat maps (or kicks them on standard maps); Traitors are killed if they touch flags, cannot touch switches, cannot vote or open the Options menu, and remain locked to the Traitor team.

Explicit bans and Simulated Base mode: In standard Combat mode, Assault and Defender armors cannot buy the basic Chaingun or BulletAmmo, Assault cannot buy ShieldPack, and Defender cannot buy RepairPack. If a server or vote switches to Simulated Base mode ($Combat::BaseItems = true), all Tribal Combat weapons, ammo, packs, deployables, turrets, mines, structures, teleporters, drones, Speeder/Assault Craft/Bomber vehicles, Special slot abilities, Sniper respawn gear, and weapon mode switching are disabled ($InvList, $RemoteInvList, and $VehicleInvList set to 0) for a stricter tweaked-base ruleset.
